terms.description: This master agreement governs access, registration, and use of the technological infrastructure, software gateway, and multi-store marketplace services of TAPTRADE SpA. It is legally binding for buyers, affiliated stores (LGS), and Buylist engine users.

introduccion.title: Introduction
introduccion.p1: Welcome to TapTrade, the SaaS platform and comprehensive marketplace for Trading Card Games (TCG) and collectibles in Chile. These policies, terms, and conditions govern your use of the platform and transactions between buyers and member stores. By using the platform or making a purchase, you agree to these binding policies.
introduccion.p2: TapTrade SpA reserves the right to update, modify, or change these policies at any time to adapt to legal or technical standards. It is the user's responsibility to periodically review these terms.

informacion.title: Platform Information
informacion.p1: TapTrade is legally operated by TAPTRADE SpA (Tax ID 78.531.106-K), a corporation constituted under the laws of the Republic of Chile.
informacion.p2: Our headquarters are located at Padre Mariano 98 Of. 315, Providencia, Santiago, Chile. For legal or support inquiries, contact contacto@taptrade.cl or legal@taptrade.cl.

precios.title: Prices and Payments
precios.p1: All prices on our store are listed in Chilean Pesos (CLP) and include Value Added Tax (VAT / IVA).
precios.p2: We accept the following authorized payment methods: Debit and Credit cards (via secure payment gateways).
precios.p3: Full payment is required at the time of purchase. Once payment is processed and verified, an automated confirmation email is sent to the customer.

envios.title: Shipping and Deliveries
envios.p1: Products will be shipped to the address provided by the user at checkout. Shipping fees are calculated automatically based on destination and package weight.
envios.p2: We make every effort to ship and deliver within the timeframe indicated. However, we are not liable for operational delays caused directly by courier service providers.
envios.p3: The customer is strictly responsible for providing an accurate and complete delivery address. If returned due to an invalid address, the user must bear reshipment costs.
envios.scheduleDesc: Orders placed before 14:00 hrs can be picked up in store or dispatched the same day from 16:00 hrs. Subsequent orders will be processed next business day.

devoluciones.title: Returns and Refunds
devoluciones.p1: If you are not completely satisfied, you have a statutory period of 5 continuous days from delivery to return the item in identical received condition with intact seals.
devoluciones.p2: The customer assumes shipping return costs. Once inspected, a full refund will be processed within 3 business days for Credit and 6 business days for Debit.
devoluciones.p3: No returns are accepted under any circumstances for custom products, altered singles, or opened booster products.

privacidad.title: Privacy
privacidad.p1: We are committed to absolute protection and privacy of personal data. For details regarding processing and storage, please consult our Privacy Policy.

responsabilidad.title: Limitation of Liability
responsabilidad.p1: We are not liable for direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages resulting from technical use or inability to use our store.
responsabilidad.p2: We apply industry security standards to mitigate risks of technical interruptions or malware.
responsabilidad.p3: Under no circumstance shall total company liability exceed the purchase amount paid by the customer for the specific item in question.

ley.title: Governing Law and Jurisdiction
ley.p1: These policies are governed by and construed in strict accordance with the laws of the Republic of Chile.
ley.p2: Any dispute or litigation arising shall be submitted and resolved exclusively before the ordinary courts of Santiago, Chile.

disposiciones.title: General Provisions
disposiciones.p1: These terms constitute the entire binding agreement between the user and TapTrade regarding platform use, superseding prior communications.
disposiciones.p2: If any clause is held invalid by a competent court, remaining clauses remain in full force and effect.
disposiciones.p3: Failure to enforce any provision shall not be construed as a waiver of such right or provision.

creditos.title: Store Credit Policies
creditos.p1: These terms govern the use of credits granted or accumulated in the store.
creditos.t1_desc: Credits won in tournaments have a 30-day validity. Unused credits after 31 days are reduced to a maximum ceiling of $10,000 CLP.
creditos.t2_desc: Credits obtained from card buybacks do not expire. If exceeding $100,000 CLP, you have 60 days to spend the full balance.
creditos.p4_desc: Store credits may be used for any available item except:
creditos.p5_desc: Store credits cannot be combined with:

transferencias.title: Bank Transfer Payments
transferencias.p1: Orders paid via direct bank transfer must be verified with payment receipt within 24 hours of order confirmation.
transferencias.warning: Important: Unpaid orders after 24 hours will be automatically cancelled by the system, releasing inventory back for sale.

s1.title: Introduction, Parties, and Binding Acceptance
s1.p1_text: This document constitutes a legally binding agreement entered into between the User and TAPTRADE SpA (hereinafter, "TapTrade" or "the Platform"). Accessing, browsing, registering, or executing any buy or sell order on the main domain (taptrade.cl), its associated subdomains (e.g., [store].taptrade.cl), and satellite APIs implies full acceptance of these provisions.
s1.p2_text: The Platform distinguishes three user profiles:
s1.li1_text: Individuals or legal entities purchasing single cards ("Singles"), sealed boxes, or accessories through the unified catalog.
s1.li2_text: Established businesses or authorized dealers with a Chilean RUT managing inventory and selling via the SaaS infrastructure.
s1.li3_text: Collectors selling cards directly to affiliated stores in exchange for cash or Store Credit.
s1.p3_text: TapTrade services are restricted to individuals over 18 years of age with full legal capacity to enter into commercial acts under the laws of the Republic of Chile.

s2.title: Business Model (Multi-Tenant SaaS Marketplace)
s2.p1_text: TapTrade operates as a Software as a Service (SaaS) provider and marketplace facilitator. It provides technology for synchronized catalogs (Scryfall, Pokémon TCG API, Riftcodex), multi-store carts, consolidated payment processing, and shipping label generation.
s2.p2_text: Unless explicitly stated as TapTrade SpA's own inventory, the purchase agreement is perfected directly and exclusively between the selling Affiliated Store and the Buyer. The store is materially and fiscally responsible for physical custody, packaging, condition grading, and issuing the respective sales receipt or invoice.
s2.box_desc: Each store operates with its own commercial policies, shipping addresses, and business hours, which are transparently displayed on its storefront or dedicated subdomain.

s3.title: Registration, Security, and Store KYC Verification
s3.p1_text: Users must provide accurate, complete, and up-to-date information upon registration. Identity impersonation or creating multiple accounts for fraudulent purposes is strictly prohibited.
s3.p2_text: To enable a store, receive payments, and sell to the public, the holder must verify:
s3.li1: Valid Chilean RUT (individual or legal entity incorporated in Chile).
s3.li2: Tax registration (Inicio de Actividades) before the Chilean Internal Revenue Service (SII) in 1st Category with retail or e-commerce business codes.
s3.li3: Ownership of a commercial bank account in a regulated financial institution in Chile.
s3.p3: TapTrade reserves the right to audit, suspend, or terminate stores that fail to meet required tax or authenticity standards.

s4.title: Pricing, SaaS Subscription Model, and Zero Commission (0% Take Rate)
s4.p1_text: All prices set by stores on the platform are expressed in Chilean Pesos (CLP) or calculated according to the store's active exchange rate, and include legally applicable VAT (IVA) in Chile.
s4.p2_text: TapTrade charges zero commission on card or product sales transactions. 100% of the sale subtotal and shipping costs go directly to the selling store, with no hidden markups or monetary intermediation fees on sales.
s4.p3_text: TapTrade's revenue model is based exclusively on charging a fixed monthly fee for software usage, catalogs, and technological infrastructure, with tiered plans based on total catalog capacity (accumulated SKUs of single cards, sealed products, and accessories):
s4.p4_label: 4.4. Holding Structure and Physical Branch Network:
s4.p4_text: Any contracted plan includes 1 base Headquarters. Companies operating more than one physical store or warehouse can add additional branches for +2.50 UF/mo (+ VAT) each, maintaining a single commercial RUT and unified settlement account, with independent inventories, POS cash registers, staff, and in-store pickup.
s4.p5_text: Each branch includes the base staff required to operate (1 Owner, 1 Accountant, 1 Manager, and 1 Cashier). If additional cashier terminals or accounts are needed for simultaneous checkout points at the physical Point of Sale, each extra cashier costs +0.35 UF/mo (+ VAT).
s4.p6_text: TapTrade does not segment technical support into artificial paid tiers or downgrade entry plans. All affiliated stores, regardless of plan, access the same level of direct technical support via WhatsApp, chat, and email for resolving operational issues and technical inquiries.
s4.p7_text: TapTrade administration may agree upon and configure preferential discount percentages or amounts on the monthly software fee for pioneer stores or specific commercial agreements.
s4.p8_title: 4.8. Transparent Breakdown of Service Fees, Payment Gateway, and Buyer Protection:
s4.p8_text: TapTrade's checkout transparently itemizes for the Buyer: (i) TapTrade Fee (3.00% net + 19% VAT): covers technological intermediation, temporary escrow custody of funds, TCG card authenticity guarantee, and unified checkout infrastructure; and (ii) Payment Gateway Cost: covers acquiring and secure bank processing fees (Transbank Webpay Plus or Mercado Pago) calculated with applicable VAT. Both items are itemized in the order summary, ensuring Affiliated Stores receive 100% of the value of their products and shipping costs (0% Store Take Rate). TapTrade SpA will issue an Electronic Service Receipt to the Buyer for its intermediation fee.
s4.p9_label: 4.9. Commercial Mandate for Third-Party Collection and Settlement:
s4.p9_text: The Affiliated Store grants TapTrade SpA an express commercial mandate to act on its behalf as a collection, billing, and temporary custody agent for funds paid by Buyers on the Platform. Consequently, the Affiliated Store is the sole tax entity required to issue the Electronic Sales Receipt or Invoice to the final Buyer for transacted products and shipping. TapTrade SpA will periodically account for collected funds and transfer 100% of sales and shipping values to the Store's registered commercial bank account.

s5.title: TCG Grading Standards and Zero Tolerance for Counterfeits
s5.p1_text: To ensure uniformity across the Chilean market, all listed cards must adhere to the following scale:
s5.c1_desc: No visible wear from play. Allows minimal factory cut or packaging micro-wear barely perceptible to the naked eye.
s5.c2_desc: Slight edgewear or minor surface scuffs, imperceptible when placed inside a protective sleeve.
s5.c3_desc: Visible wear from regular play on corners and edges, loss of gloss, or moderate marks without structural creases.
s5.c4_desc: Severe wear, pronounced border whitening, or minor creases. Tournament-legal in opaque double sleeves.
s5.c5_desc: Tears, heavy creases, ink stains, water damage, or obvious structural deformations.
s5.zero_desc: The sale of unauthorized reproductions, counterfeit cards, or undeclared proxies is strictly prohibited. Selling inauthentic material will result in immediate termination of the offending store, a full refund to the buyer, and reporting to courts and competent authorities.

s6.title: Logistics, Integrated Shipping, and In-Store Pickup
s6.p1_text: TapTrade operates synchronized with the official APIs of Chilexpress and Starken, dynamically quoting freight based on weight, dimensions, and geographic distance between the store's origin and the buyer's destination.
s6.p2_text: When a store has a physical retail location, the buyer may choose to pick up their cards at no shipping cost by presenting their ID and purchase order number.
s6.p3_text: Affiliated stores have a strict deadline of 24 to 48 business hours to dispatch cards protected in sleeves and semi-rigid protectors or toploaders to prevent bending or friction damage in transit.
s6.p4_text: In the event of loss or damage attributable to the courier company during transit, TapTrade will manage the formal claim with the logistics carrier, guaranteeing compensation or a refund to the buyer.

s7.title: Buylist Engine and Store Credit Wallet
s7.p1_text: The Buylist engine allows collectors to sell their cards to registered stores applying automatic valuation factors based on condition and language. The store has the right to physically verify the condition of the cards upon receipt before transferring final payment.
s7.p2_text: When a Buylist settlement is paid in "Store Credit":
s7.li1: The balance is recorded in the user's virtual wallet and is redeemable exclusively for purchases within the catalog of the same Affiliated Store that issued it.
s7.li2: It is not redeemable for cash directly from TapTrade SpA nor transferable to accounts at other stores.
s7.li3: The issuing store is financially responsible for guaranteeing catalog availability for the redemption of issued credits.

s8.title: Legal Warranty, No Right of Withdrawal on Singles, and Returns
s8.box_title: Legal Exclusion of Right of Withdrawal on Single Cards
s8.box_desc: Pursuant to Article 3 bis letter b) of Law No. 19.496 on Consumer Rights Protection, the unilateral right of withdrawal does not apply to the purchase of collectible single cards (Singles), as they are goods subject to immediate fluctuations in independent secondary markets, nor to sealed products that have been opened or unsealed.
s8.p1_text: If a received card exhibits undisclosed factory defects or an obvious, unjustifiable discrepancy compared to the contracted condition (e.g., paid for Near Mint and received a heavily damaged copy):
s8.li1: The buyer must report the case to soporte@taptrade.cl within 48 continuous hours after delivery.
s8.li2: Clear and detailed photographs of the card, seals, and original packaging must be attached, along with a continuous unboxing video of the sealed parcel. For orders covered by TapTrade Shield (≥ $10,000 CLP), cases are audited against the 3 photos recorded by the store prior to dispatch.
s8.li3: Once non-conformity is verified, the buyer is entitled to a replacement copy or a full refund following the physical return of the item.
s8.li4: Failure to provide a continuous unboxing video of the sealed package automatically dismisses claims for condition discrepancies or swapped cards, protecting both parties against fraud.

s9.title: Intellectual Property and First Sale Doctrine
s9.p1_text: The software code, visual design, "TapTrade" trademark, logos, interfaces, algorithms, and databases are the exclusive intellectual property of TAPTRADE SpA protected under Law No. 17.336.
s9.p2_label: 9.2. Third-Party Trademarks and First Sale Doctrine:
s9.p2_text: All trade names, franchises, characters, and game logos mentioned on the platform, including:
s9.brands: • Magic: The Gathering (Wizards of the Coast / Hasbro) • Pokémon TCG (Nintendo / Creatures / Game Freak / The Pokémon Company) • One Piece Card Game (Bandai / Eiichiro Oda / Shueisha) • Disney Lorcana (Ravensburger / Disney) • Gundam Card Game (Bandai Namco) • Riftbound TCG (Riot Games / League of Legends)
s9.p3: Belong to their respective owners. TapTrade SpA is an independent technology entity and has no corporate affiliation with said companies. Their use on the platform is strictly for identification, reference, and descriptive purposes for lawful secondary market commerce under the universal exhaustion of rights / first sale doctrine.

s10.title: Personal Data Protection and Privacy
s10.p1_text: TapTrade processes personal data in accordance with Chile's New Personal Data Protection Law (Bulletin No. 11.144-07 / amended Law No. 19.628). Information is collected exclusively for executing purchase contracts, coordinating shipping logistics, and issuing tax receipts or invoices before the Internal Revenue Service (SII).
s10.p2_text: Data subjects enjoy the rights of Access, Rectification, Cancellation, Opposition, Portability, and Blocking, which they may exercise free of charge at privacidad@taptrade.cl. TapTrade does not sell, trade, or rent user information to third parties unrelated to essential transactional and logistics operations. Full details are described in our

s11.title: Limitation of Liability and Indemnity
s11.p1_text: TapTrade makes its best technical efforts to ensure service continuity, but is not liable for outages caused by international connectivity disruptions, third-party provider failures, or force majeure.
s11.p2_text: To the extent permitted by Chilean law, TapTrade SpA's contractual or tort liability toward stores shall be capped at a maximum amount equal to the last monthly SaaS subscription fee paid by the affected store.

s12.title: Applicable Law, Special Domicile, and Jurisdiction
s12.p1_text: This agreement is governed, interpreted, and executed under the laws in force in the Republic of Chile.
s12.p2_text: For all legal purposes arising from the use of the platform or the validity and interpretation of this contract, the parties establish their domicile in the commune of Santiago, Chile, and submit to the jurisdiction of its Ordinary Courts of Justice.
s12.cta_desc: Our legal and tax team will respond promptly.

privacy.mainTitle: Privacy Policy and Personal Data Processing
privacy.badge: Compliant with the New Personal Data Protection Law
privacy.description: At TAPTRADE SpA we are committed to guaranteeing maximum security, confidentiality, and transparency in the processing of personal data of our users, buyers, sellers, and visitors. This policy is strictly aligned with Chile's New Personal Data Protection Law (amendment to Law No. 19.628, creation of the Personal Data Protection Agency - ANPD) and international privacy standards.

introduccion.p1: This Privacy Policy describes how your personal information is collected, used, and shared when you visit or make a purchase on our portal.

informacion.title: What Personal Information We Collect
informacion.p1: When you visit the site, we automatically collect device information, including browser details, IP address, timezone, and cookies.
informacion.p2: As you browse, we collect information on individual pages and products viewed, referring search terms, and platform interactions.
informacion.techLi1: Cookies: Small data files placed on your computer often including an anonymous unique identifier.
informacion.techLi2: Log Files: Track actions on the site and record IP address, browser type, ISP, and timestamps.
informacion.orderDesc: When making a purchase, we securely collect name, billing address, shipping address, payment details, email, and phone number.
informacion.p3: Personal Information refers to both Device and Order Information.

uso.title: How We Use Your Personal Information
uso.p1: We use Order Information to fulfill purchases (processing payments, shipping logistics, and issuing invoices).
uso.listTitle: Additionally, we use Order Information to:
uso.listLi2: Screen orders for potential risk or fraud.
uso.listLi3: Provide information and targeted promotions per your preferences.
uso.p2: We use Device Information to assist in fraud screening and improve site performance.

compartir.title: Sharing Your Personal Information
compartir.p1: We share Personal Information with logistics couriers, authorized payment gateways, and analytics to serve orders effectively.
compartir.analyticsDesc: We use Google Analytics to analyze customer interaction and improve product catalogs.
compartir.p2: We may disclose Personal Information to comply with applicable Chilean laws, subpoena requests, or protect legal rights.

retencion.title: Data Retention
retencion.p1: We maintain Order Information for accounting and warranty verification unless requested for deletion via official channels.

contacto.title: Policy Changes and Contact
contacto.p1: We may update this policy periodically to reflect operational, legal, or regulatory modifications under Chilean law.
contacto.boxDesc: Reach out to us directly and we will respond promptly.

s1.title: Data Controller and Applicable Legal Framework
s1.p1: The controller of the databases generated through the official website www.taptrade.cl and its associated applications is TAPTRADE SpA, a joint-stock company incorporated under the laws of the Republic of Chile, RUT No. 78.531.106-K, domiciled in Santiago, Chile.
s1.p2: This policy governs data collection, recording, storage, processing, communication, and deletion operations in strict compliance with the current Chilean legal framework, particularly:
s1.li1: New Personal Data Protection Law (Bulletin No. 11.144-07, modernizing Law No. 19.628 and aligning the Chilean framework with European GDPR and OECD standards).
s1.li2: Law No. 19.496 on Consumer Rights Protection (SERNAC).
s1.li3: Decree Law No. 825 and the Chilean Tax Code regarding the issuance of electronic tax documents before the Internal Revenue Service (SII).

s2.title: Guiding Principles of Data Processing
s2.p1: In compliance with Chilean legislation, all personal data processing at TapTrade is mandatorily governed by the following guiding principles:
s2.c1_desc: Data is always processed on a valid legal basis, transparently and without deception toward the data subject.
s2.c2_desc: Data is collected solely for specific, explicit, and legitimate purposes linked to the marketplace and shipping.
s2.c3_desc: We only request data strictly necessary to process your purchases, issue receipts, and dispatch packages.
s2.c4_desc: We apply TLS 1.3 encryption, secure servers, and strict access controls to protect your data against unauthorized access.

s3.title: Lawful Bases for Processing
s3.p1: TapTrade processes your personal data exclusively when at least one of the following legal bases authorized by Chilean law applies:
s3.b1_desc: Processing is essential to create your account, process payment for your cards, coordinate with Starken/Chilexpress, and deliver your orders.
s3.b2_desc: Granted upon registering on the platform through free and voluntary acceptance of this Privacy Policy.
s3.b3_desc: Tax obligation to issue and retain electronic receipts or invoices required by the Internal Revenue Service (SII).
s3.b4_desc: Prevention of electronic fraud, infrastructure protection against cyberattacks, and mitigation of suspicious transactions.

s4.title: Categories of Personal Data Collected
s4.p1: To operate the marketplace and provide TCG card buying and selling services, we collect the following categories of data:
s4.catA_li2: Email address (used as a unique identifier).
s4.catA_li3: Password stored under an irreversible one-way cryptographic hash.
s4.catA_li4: RUT (if a commercial invoice or LGS store registration is required).
s4.catB_li1: Name of the person receiving the package.
s4.catB_li2: Official destination Region and Commune in Chile.
s4.catB_li3: Street, house/apartment number, and delivery notes.
s4.catB_li4: Contact phone number for the carrier (Starken / Chilexpress).

s5.title: Specific Purposes of Processing
s5.p1: Collected personal data is used exclusively for the following purposes:
s5.li1_desc: Inventory validation, transaction billing, escrow custody, and settlement to selling stores.
s5.li2_desc: Automated transmission of shipping information to Starken or Chilexpress for label printing and live tracking.
s5.li3_desc: Sending purchase confirmation emails, tracking numbers, and alerts when the package is ready for pickup or delivered.
s5.li4_desc: Crediting Store Credit balances and verifying cards sold by collectors to affiliated stores.
s5.li5_desc: Prevention of abusive access and automated bot detection via Cloudflare Turnstile.

s6.title: Banking Security and Credit/Debit Cards
s6.p1: TapTrade does not store, process, or have access under any circumstances to your full credit or debit card numbers, expiration dates, or CVV/CVC security codes.
s6.p2: All payment transactions are processed directly on the secure, encrypted servers of payment gateways authorized and supervised by the Financial Market Commission (CMF), such as Transbank (Webpay Plus) and MercadoPago. TapTrade only receives an encrypted digital confirmation of the payment outcome (approved or rejected).

s7.title: Data Disclosure to Third Parties and Data Processors
s7.p1: To enable physical delivery of your cards and software operation, we share only strictly indispensable data with the following third parties:
s7.t1_desc: We share your name, phone number, and shipping address with Starken and Chilexpress to issue shipping orders and physically deliver packages.
s7.t2_desc: When you purchase cards from an affiliated store, it receives exclusively the data required to label and package your order, and is contractually bound to respect the confidentiality of your information.
s7.t3_desc: Cloud database and web hosting servers with ISO 27001 and SOC 2 security certifications, operating under data processing agreements with high encryption standards.
s7.warn: Absolute Prohibition of Commercialization: TapTrade NEVER sells, rents, or transfers your personal data under any circumstances to advertising agencies, telemarketers, or third parties unrelated to completing your purchase.

s8.title: Data Subject Rights (ARCO+ Rights)
s8.p1: In accordance with Chile's New Personal Data Protection Law, every user enjoys the following inalienable and enforceable rights before TapTrade:
s8.r1_desc: Right to request and receive free information about your personal data we process, its origin, purpose, and recipients.
s8.r2_desc: Right to demand correction or updating of your personal data when inaccurate, incomplete, or outdated.
s8.r3_desc: Right to request permanent deletion of your personal data when the legal retention period has expired or there is no duty to retain it.
s8.r4_desc: Right to object at any time to the use of your data for advertising, special offers, or marketing purposes.
s8.r5_desc: Right to receive a copy of your personal data in a structured, commonly used, and machine-readable digital format (JSON/CSV).
s8.r6_desc: Right to temporarily suspend the use of your data while a rectification or challenge request is being processed.

s9.title: Procedure and Deadlines for Exercising Your Rights
s9.p1: You may exercise any of your ARCO+ rights completely free of charge through the following channels:
s9.p2_text: In accordance with Chilean legal standards, TapTrade will respond to and resolve your request within a maximum of 15 business days from receipt. To safeguard the data subject's identity, we may request reliable verification before modifying or deleting the account.

s10.title: Supervisory Authority and State Claims
s10.p1: If you believe your personal data protection rights have not been properly addressed by TapTrade within the legal deadline, Chilean law expressly entitles you to file a formal claim before the competent state authority:
s10.box_desc: Autonomous state body empowered by law to oversee compliance with personal data regulations, conduct investigations, and impose sanctions on controllers that breach their legal duties. You may also pursue appropriate legal actions before the ordinary courts of justice of the Republic of Chile.

s11.title: Security Measures and Breach Protocol
s11.p1: TapTrade implements state-of-the-art technical and organizational measures to prevent loss, theft, alteration, or unauthorized access to your personal data:
s11.li1_desc: All traffic between your browser and the platform travels protected by SSL/TLS certificates with 256-bit encryption (HTTPS).
s11.li2_desc: User passwords are processed with one-way hashing and salting algorithms (bcrypt). Neither support staff nor TapTrade administrators have access to your plaintext password.
s11.li3_desc: Cloudflare Turnstile integration to prevent brute-force or credential-stuffing attacks.
s11.li4_desc: In the unlikely event of a security breach significantly affecting your data, TapTrade will notify affected users and the regulatory authority within legally required timeframes, detailing the mitigation measures adopted.

s12.title: Data Retention Period and Deletion
s12.p1: Your personal data will be retained only for the time necessary to fulfill the described purposes or as required by legal deadlines:
s12.li1_desc: Retained as long as your account remains active on the platform.
s12.li2_desc: Information associated with purchases, receipts, and electronic invoices is retained for the legal period of 6 years required by the Chilean Internal Revenue Service (SII) for tax and accounting audit purposes.
s12.li3_desc: Once said period expires or upon a valid deletion request, data will be securely destroyed or anonymized for purely statistical purposes.

s13.title: Use of Cookies and Similar Technologies
s13.p1: TapTrade uses essential technical cookies to keep your session active, remember cards added to your shopping cart, and protect the site against malicious access.
s13.p2: You can configure or disable cookies at any time in your web browser preferences. However, please note that disabling essential technical cookies may prevent the shopping cart and account login from functioning properly.
